g.title: j2169814383
g.text: I heard about what happened to Kaya
About what some little comadreja de mierda did to her

g.title: j757000
g.text: Uh oh.

g.title: j1315773324
g.text: Yeah...

g.title: j2590712682
g.text: I do not know how
I do not know if it is ever possible
But you break the laws of time and space

g.title: j2614887243
g.text: I want to find him
And I want to bring him here
And I want to sit him down in front of all of us

g.title: j1664541118
g.text: And then what?

g.title: j934447715
g.text: We can't hurt some random teenager.

g.title: j2692704724
g.text: I want to make him feel what it's like when he's the one who's scared and the whole world is against them
When everyone is laughing at him
Mocking him

g.title: j1129414626
g.text: Who says that was the plan
I know his type
Cowards, all of them, whipping words from where they think its safe

g.title: j3513876651
g.text: Do you know what it was like growing up looking like me?
Sounding like me?
Dressing like me?
Surrounded by children on military bases who didn't?

g.title: j1589483256
g.text: I'd come home beat up more often than not because I stood up for myself
Mi mamá would always tsk and say I should've kept my head down
¿Quedarme callada?
Like hell

g.text: Check boolean KayaFutureWin2

g.title: j739575292
g.text: I don't blame her for wanting to run away

But
Notice she doesn't stay gone?

g.text: JAJAJA remind me never to set you as emergency contact

g.text: Sometimes it just takes time

g.text: Doesn't help that she teleports
